title: Visitation (KINO)
synopsis: At its heart is a place: a house on a lake near Berlin, home to three families from the 1930s to the fall of the Wall. A Jewish family is forced to sell; an architect builds his Bauhaus dream and chases it again in the GDR; a writer couple returns from Soviet exile. Twelve people dream of a home while world history refuses to spare their small shore. Adapting Jenny Erpenbeck's novel, Palme d'Or winner Volker Schlöndorff crafts a textured, compassionate epic with Lars Eidinger and Martina Gedeck that premiered in Cannes, a fitting late career triumph.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 湖邊的小屋像是帶著神秘，承載的原來是百年德國近代史的痛與悲，見證過納粹鐵蹄、蘇聯侵佔、兩德統一。三代人、三個家庭，包括被迫逃亡的猶太裔布商、與東德國家命運相連的建築師，以及被蘇聯流放回來的作家。每個人都視這裡為家、但卻未能在此紮根，只能隨著時代順流與逆流漂泊。憑《錫鼓》揚威國際影壇的87歲殿堂級導演伏加舒倫杜夫，透過一間小屋側寫十二個角色的前塵往事，氣魄恢宏，更獲今年康城影展選為首映單元電影。

cast: Detlev Buck, Stella Denis-Winkler, Lars Eidinger
